## Coming from BacaKomik?
On Android, Yoru is a new app next to BacaKomik. Before you uninstall BacaKomik, bring your library over: sync it with Drive in BacaKomik and sign in to Drive sync in Yoru, or back it up in BacaKomik and restore the file in Yoru (More → Backup & sync). The 2.17.0 notes have the details.

## Changes

### Changed
- The splash screen says Comic Reader App under the name.

### Fixed
- Desktop: Mihon extensions now use DNS over HTTPS (More → DNS over HTTPS), as on Android, so sites your network's DNS blocks load again. The update downloads the extensions' runtime once more, about 100 MB. The in-app WebView still uses the system DNS.
